# Roster

The roster coordinates peers working across projects.

## Rules

1. Every task names the exact files it may touch; a peer writes only those named paths and nothing else.
2. Objectives live in `objectives/`, tasks in `tasks/`, decisions in [decisions](decisions.md).
3. A task is done only after a verify report is attached.
4. Meeting notes go to `meetings/` with the date in the file name.
